parts: 18/12/2025 07:33 is this https://tecstorm26.devpost.com/ only for student/

No — **TecStorm’26 on Devpost is *not* open to everyone**; it’s specifically for **college/university students aged 17+**. citeturn0search0

**Eligibility (from the official Devpost page):**
- Must be **ages 17 or older**  
- **College/university students only** (not open to general professionals unless you are a student)  
- Participants from all countries/territories are allowed, with standard exceptions per rules. citeturn0search0

So if you’re **not currently a student**, you typically *cannot* enter this hackathon via Devpost.  
If you *are* a student (undergrad/grad), you’re eligible as long as you meet the age and other criteria listed in the full rules. citeturn0search0
